findings.rule: spec R3: urllib_fetch opens only https:// URLs
findings.summary: With an environment http_proxy whose scheme is https:// (uncommon), ProxyHandler re-types a plain http:// request to https and _HTTPSHandler sends it to the proxy, so an http URL is fetched instead of refused; unverified, and the layer only builds https URLs, so only a direct urllib_fetch call can reach it.
